faults.why: Contains Cyrillic character 'ј' (U+0458) instead of Latin/IPA 'j'.

faults.quote: This verb takes the ablative case (-tan/-ten) when leaving a place.
faults.why: Gives only assimilated voiceless forms; basic ablative suffix after vowels and voiced consonants is -dan/-den.
